title: New Content Pill
description: Stops live feeds shifting posts under the reader's finger by holding new arrivals behind a "5 new posts" pill that inserts and scrolls up on tap, inserting directly only when the reader is at the top (or scrolls back up to it) and not mid-press; works in its own scroll box or on a page that scrolls as a whole (scrollTarget="window").
stops: Feed jumped while I was tapping
